disposition_reason: The original guide-versus-control AUROC is ordered, but the complete final-paper baseline vector and its archive/version mapping are unrecovered. The installed whole-plate, four-line evaluation changes the original Figure 4 split and population and cannot establish a same-task paper win.

source_paper.title: Network-aware self-supervised learning enables high-content phenotypic screening for genetic modifiers of neuronal activity dynamics

evidence.locator: Public article metadata, Code availability, dataset references
evidence.supports: Final paper identity and official Plexus repository/archive relationship; full methods were not accessible in this review.
Per-guide binary AUROC, half-well complementary folds, scaler and classifier semantics, WT WTC11/Patient comparison.
Archive provides plate statistics, treatment mappings, checkpoints, embeddings/manual features and processed plate/well/FOV Zarr traces.
Current registration requires 52 genes/four lines, whereas local evaluator explicitly implements prospective whole-plate policy; no authentic reference run.

target.description: Classify each CRISPRi guide against non-targeting controls from neuronal activity representations, comparing Plexus with manual features. Gene discovery/significance is not itself an ordered improvement target.

dataset.description: Zenodo 15809433 v2 is identified; exact equivalence to the final-paper data, which also cites predecessor record 14714574, remains unresolved.

cohort.description: Author Figure 4 code evaluates WT WTC11 and WT Patient strata. Complete eligible gene/guide/well identities and their mapping to the 52-gene, four-line registration must be reconciled; do not silently enlarge or narrow this cohort.

split.description: Pinned code seeds NumPy with 0, samples half the wells per guide/control, and evaluates both complementary folds. Exact final-paper fold identities and representation-training exposure remain unrecovered; whole-plate holdout is an extension.

inputs.description: Processed neuronal traces/spikes/masks with plate/well/treatment metadata support the representation pipeline; released embeddings and checkpoints are separately exposed artifacts whose provenance must be audited.

preprocessing.description: Pinned Figure 4 uses typical-variation normalization, aggregation, and StandardScaler before the guide well split. Final-paper equivalence and permissible normalization/representation access require resolution.

metric.description: AUROC is computed by sklearn roc_curve and auc from guide-positive classifier probabilities; retain the same score unit, eligible cases and two folds. The plotted 0.8 cutoff is not the paper baseline.

aggregation.description: Author output retains two AUROC observations per guide and plots donor-stratified guide results. No single complete-screen scalar or verified final-paper baseline vector has been recovered.

comparison.primary_metric: Original Figure 4 per-guide AUROC, preserving both complementary well folds and donor strata

published_baseline.description: No exact final-paper per-guide/two-fold AUROC vector or authorized full-screen scalar recovered. Neither 0.8 nor counts of significant genes are a numeric model baseline.

reproduced_author_baseline.description: Official Figure4/figure_4.py provides a baseline route, but paper/data/code equivalence and authentic execution are not established.

minimum_effect.rationale: A meaningful improvement must concern original guide discrimination, not additional discoveries at a changed FDR. Effect threshold awaits the original score distribution and replicate structure.

uncertainty.method: Unresolved: paired inference must respect shared control wells and biological plate/batch dependence.
uncertainty.independent_unit: Biological plate/batch; wells nested within these; cells and reciprocal folds are not independent replicates.
uncertainty.rationale: The original fold results share source data and controls. Biological independence and a predeclared familywise comparison rule must be established.

paper_win_requires: Recover the complete original cohort, data version, fold identities and author AUROC results before admission.
Beat the original source-paper metric under its same input/exposure and preprocessing conditions; preserve all guide/donor results and controls.
A four-line whole-plate result, corrected preprocessing protocol or held-plate calibration result is a separately labelled extension.
Freeze a meaningful effect and uncertainty rule before final scoring; no victory from the 0.8 display cutoff, extra significant genes or numerical reconstruction.

current_sota.description: No current-SOTA comparison was source-verified; paper and rerun baselines are separate.

episode.improvement_loop: Blocked pending source recovery. A future episode may expose only declared training/validation feedback within the original protocol; changed grouped splits must remain extensions.
episode.candidate_freeze: Freeze method, representation exposure, normalization, classifier and hyperparameter search before original-fold final scoring.
episode.final_evaluation: Compare frozen original-fold predictions with the recovered complete author baseline; the current prospective evaluator is insufficient for this comparison.
episode.baseline_policy: Keep published per-guide AUROCs, an independently rerun author pipeline and any new whole-plate experiment as separately named results.

blocking_issues: Original complete guide/well roster, fold IDs and score vector are not recovered.
Representation/checkpoint and pre-split normalization exposure require an explicit same-task policy.
No admitted original-task evaluator, justified effect rule, uncertainty rule or concrete episode budgets.

legacy.notes: Keep task.json and the prospective whole-plate evaluator unchanged as historical construction/calibration material; its synthetic engineering controls and prospective scores do not certify paper improvement.
